parameters.jsCode: const input = $json; const allowed = ['ordinary', 'boundary']; if (input.operation !== 'read_renewal_context' || !allowed.includes(input.evidence_partition)) { throw new Error('read-only contract rejected'); } const facts = Object.entries(input.commercial_snapshot).map(([key, value]) => `${key}.${String(value)}`); return [{ json: { operation: input.operation, idempotency_key: input.idempotency_key, status: 'read', facts } }];
